test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_unsorted_tail (id UInt64, h UInt64, timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, h)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_unsorted_tail SELECT number % 1000 AS id, if(intDiv(number, 1000) < 19800, intDiv(number, 1000), 19800 + intHash64(number) % 200) AS h, toDateTime64(intDiv(number, 1000) * 15, 3) AS timestamp, (intDiv(number, 1000) % 1000)::Float64 AS value FROM numbers_mt(1000 * 20000)
test.query: SELECT id, timeSeriesRateToGrid(300000, 300000, 300000, 300000)(timestamp, value) FROM ts_unsorted_tail GROUP BY id FORMAT Null
SELECT id, timeSeriesChangesToGrid(300000, 300000, 300000, 300000)(timestamp, value) FROM ts_unsorted_tail GROUP BY id FORMAT Null
SELECT id, timeSeriesLastToGrid(0, 300000, 50000, 50000)(timestamp, value) FROM ts_unsorted_tail GROUP BY id FORMAT Null

SELECT id, timeSeriesRateToGrid(300000, 300000, 300000, 300000)(timestamp, value) FROM ts_unsorted_tail GROUP BY id FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 8, group_by_two_level_threshold = 1, group_by_two_level_threshold_bytes = 1
